description:
Song Da-Na is a planning PD of a webtoon production company and a makeup YouTuber with 240,000 subscribers. During a makeup live for a movie, her boyfriend suddenly comes to her house and shows her shocking appearance. With a sore head from the aftereffects of a breakup, a hangover, and even rude coworkers who rush at her as soon as she gets to work, her team junior, Kim Seok-Jin, showcases her videos during a meeting and announces that he will plan a webtoon centered around YouTubers ! 

"Did he do it on purpose because he knew it was me ?"

She gets really drunk and ends up confessing her double life to him. The next day, Seok-Jin blackmail her to cooperate on the project.
